about: Yorkton is a city in east-central Saskatchewan on the Yellowhead Highway, a regional hub for parkland agriculture between Regina and the Manitoba border. Grain elevators, a compact downtown, and the long-running Yorkton Film Festival shape civic identity. About 16,000 people live in Yorkton.
seoSummary: East-central Saskatchewan city on the Yellowhead Highway, a parkland agribusiness and film-festival hub.
